entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""I'd like to begin by giving Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to begin by giving President Rayne a chance to speak about his decision to form a new party."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""On to the next question.""
entries.dialogueText: "On to the next question."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The USP is stuck in the past. I fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The USP is stuck in the past. I founded a new party to turn Sordland into the modern, competitive nation it is destined to become."
entries.menuText: "The USP is stuck in the past. I founded a new party to turn Sordland into the modern, competitive nation it is destined to become."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""What exactly does the Democrat Par..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly does the Democrat Party have to offer that the USP did not?"

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""What exactly does the Liberal Part..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly does the Liberal Party have to offer that the USP did not?"

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""What exactly does the Maroon Party..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly does the Maroon Party have to offer that the USP did not?"

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""What exactly does the Sordish Pros..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly does the Sordish Prosperity Party have to offer that the USP did not?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My new party is a chance to return..."
entries.dialogueText: "My new party is a chance to return Sordland to its Sollist roots. The Colonel of 20 years ago would not recognize what the USP has become today."
entries.menuText: "My new party is a chance to return Sordland to its Sollist roots. The Colonel of 20 years ago would not recognize what the USP has become today."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The USP has forgotten who it serve..."
entries.dialogueText: "The USP has forgotten who it serves: the Sordish people. With my new party, everyone will have a voice."
entries.menuText: "The USP has forgotten who it serves: the Sordish people. With my new party, everyone will have a voice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The USP has forgotten what the 'S'..."
entries.dialogueText: "The USP has forgotten what the 'S' in its name stands for. My new party will put Sordland first."
entries.menuText: "The USP has forgotten what the 'S' in its name stands for. My new party will put Sordland first."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In a word, money. The USP has had..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a word, money. The USP has had a chokehold on the economy for too long. It's time to give Sordish businesses a chance to thrive."
entries.menuText: "In a word, money. The USP has had a chokehold on the economy for too long. It's time to give Sordish businesses a chance to thrive."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The moderator motioned for silence."
entries.dialogueText: The moderator motioned for silence.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Spoken like a true puppet of the O..."
entries.dialogueText: "Spoken like a true puppet of the Oligarchs."

entries.speaker: Moderator
entries.title: Moderator: ""What exactly does the People's Par..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly does the People's Party have to offer that the USP did not?"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""By nationalizing them, you mean? R..."
entries.dialogueText: "By nationalizing them, you mean? Ridiculous!"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""How can you possibly say that afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "How can you possibly say that after what you did to him?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Preposterous. Any follower of Soll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Preposterous. Any follower of Soll would stay true to the party he founded."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Any true Sordish patriot would hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any true Sordish patriot would have joined the NFP. You're in this for yourself, Rayne."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Your allegiances show where your p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your allegiances show where your petty priorities lie. This is not about the rise of the Sordish people but your own individual ego, Rayne."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Ah, so you eliminated the NFP lead..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, so you eliminated the NFP leadership so you could take on its values for yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can be proud of my country witho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can be proud of my country without being a bigot."
entries.menuText: "I can be proud of my country without being a bigot."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The NFP doesn't think big enough...."
entries.dialogueText: "The NFP doesn't think big enough. My party will crush all of Sordland's enemies."
entries.menuText: "The NFP doesn't think big enough. My party will crush all of Sordland's enemies."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To be honest, I just plain don't l..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the NFP."
entries.menuText: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the NFP."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm prepared to ally with the NFP.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm prepared to ally with the NFP."
entries.menuText: "I'm prepared to ally with the NFP."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I liked Soll's ideas. Not the man..."
entries.dialogueText: "I liked Soll's ideas. Not the man himself."
entries.menuText: "I liked Soll's ideas. Not the man himself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not after the way I was betrayed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not after the way I was betrayed."
entries.menuText: "Not after the way I was betrayed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. It's time to take his ideas an..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. It's time to take his ideas and bring them into our modern age."
entries.menuText: "No. It's time to take his ideas and bring them into our modern age."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Honestly, I just couldn't stomach..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, I just couldn't stomach the thought of you as president."
entries.menuText: "Honestly, I just couldn't stomach the thought of you as president."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Soll betrayed his own ideals. He h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soll betrayed his own ideals. He had to go."
entries.menuText: "Soll betrayed his own ideals. He had to go."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""If you really wanted Sordland to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you really wanted Sordland to have a chance at democracy, you would have endorsed the PFJP after your Congress loss."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""If you really wanted Sordland to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you really wanted Sordland to have a chance at democracy, you would have endorsed the PFJP after your Congress loss."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Ah, so you eliminated the PFJP lea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, so you eliminated the PFJP leadership so you could take on its values for yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To be honest, I just plain don't l..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the PFJP."
entries.menuText: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the PFJP."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm prepared to ally with the PFJP.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm prepared to ally with the PFJP."
entries.menuText: "I'm prepared to ally with the PFJP."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, the PFJP is too capitalist for..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, the PFJP is too capitalist for my tastes."
entries.menuText: "No, the PFJP is too capitalist for my tastes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The PFJP is too globalist for me...."
entries.dialogueText: "The PFJP is too globalist for me. I want to keep the focus on Sordland."
entries.menuText: "The PFJP is too globalist for me. I want to keep the focus on Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The USP cannot admit that Malenyev..."
entries.dialogueText: "The USP cannot admit that Malenyev had the right idea. My party will finally bring communism to Sordland:"
entries.menuText: "The USP cannot admit that Malenyev had the right idea. My party will finally bring communism to Sordland:"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Any true communist would have join..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any true communist would have joined the Communist Party. You're in this for yourself, President Rayne."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm prepared to ally with the Comm..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm prepared to ally with the Communist Party."
entries.menuText: "I'm prepared to ally with the Communist Party."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To be honest, I just plain don't l..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the Communist Party."
entries.menuText: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the Communist Party."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your party is too radical, Stahler..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your party is too radical, Stahler. I'm willing to make compromises to achieve our goals."
entries.menuText: "Your party is too radical, Stahler. I'm willing to make compromises to achieve our goals."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Any true communist would not have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any true communist would not have gone against Leon Malenyev."
entries.menuText: "Any true communist would not have gone against Leon Malenyev."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""No, you founded it because you cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, you founded it because you could not admit you had lost."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm so happy I don't have to put u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm so happy I don't have to put up with another four years of you."
entries.menuText: "I'm so happy I don't have to put up with another four years of you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I still respect you, Lileas. I had..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still respect you, Lileas. I had hoped we could settle this like adults."
entries.menuText: "I still respect you, Lileas. I had hoped we could settle this like adults."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was happy to lose. It gave me th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was happy to lose. It gave me the excuse to do what I'd wanted to for years."
entries.menuText: "I was happy to lose. It gave me the excuse to do what I'd wanted to for years."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That was the initial reason, yes...."
entries.dialogueText: "That was the initial reason, yes. But I've had time to develop my platform."
entries.menuText: "That was the initial reason, yes. But I've had time to develop my platform."

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""That doesn't change the fact that--""
entries.dialogueText: "That doesn't change the fact that--"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""But if you really pay attention to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you really pay attention to what Marcia said--"

entries.speaker: Denis Stahler
entries.title: Denis Stahler: ""Then you've just lost yourself an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you've just lost yourself an ally. In fact--"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Not now. It's too risky.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not now. It's too risky."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""Never. Not after what happened to--""
entries.dialogueText: "Never. Not after what happened to--"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Fair enough. There's room in the A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough. There's room in the Assembly for both our parties. In fact--"

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""Fair enough. There's room in the A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough. There's room in the Assembly for both our parties. In fact--"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""At last, something we agree on.""
entries.dialogueText: "At last, something we agree on."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Not now. It's too risky.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not now. It's too risky."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Never. Not after what happened to--""
entries.dialogueText: "Never. Not after what happened to--"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm going to enjoy crushing you at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to enjoy crushing you at the polls."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You were such a bright boy, Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were such a bright boy, President Rayne. What happened?"

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Come over here and say that to my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come over here and say that to my face. I doubt that you have the same will as we do."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Such crude language, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Such crude language, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""A valid sentiment.""
entries.dialogueText: "A valid sentiment."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""With my help, you could have. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my help, you could have. You don't have a prayer now."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Not if we crush you with our iron..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not if we crush you with our iron will first."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Big ambitions for such a unimagina..."
entries.dialogueText: "Big ambitions for such a unimaginative party."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You traitor!""
entries.dialogueText: "You traitor!"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Saving one's own party is hardly a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Saving one's own party is hardly a 'betrayal' --"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""All this talk of modernity, yet yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "All this talk of modernity, yet you--"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The feeling is mutual.""
entries.dialogueText: "The feeling is mutual."

entries.speaker: Manoly Suheil
entries.title: Manoly Suheil: ""By nationalizing them, you mean? R..."
entries.dialogueText: "By nationalizing them, you mean? Ridiculous!"
